added_failures_note: the reviewed run's own baseline_suite (base_arm.log, 446 passed, EXIT=0) and after_suite (head_arm.log, 453 passed, EXIT=0) arms list no failing node ids, so the head arm adds zero failure ids; derived with reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs after a positive control confirmed the parser finds the one FAILED id in negative_control.log.

findings.text: the reuse cache is not keyed on the stall window, and a reused snapshot's window is frozen on the entry, not taken from the caller. _snapshot_reuse_key (recovery.py:7945) hashes the classification inputs, the newest stream and the promotion row but not stall_seconds; _refresh_snapshot (recovery.py:8038) re-derives state from snapshot['stall_window_seconds'], and cache=None callers share the module-level _SNAPSHOT_CACHE (recovery.py:7985), which watch_ticker alone evades by passing its own. Reproduced at head 3f907c0fa in a scratch tree with a run quiet 100s: a first call with stall_seconds=60 stores state 'stalled' window 60, and a second call, same files and same moment, asking for stall_seconds=3600 is served window 3600's own answer would be 'working' but returns state 'stalled' window 60. Three production call sites pass no cache — reckon/cli.py:2508 (default window), reckon/crew/runs.py:1336 (a configurable stall_window), recovery.py:8763 (default) — so any process that classifies one run under two windows reports the first window's verdict; the section's own parity case uses one window and cannot see it.

the recorded suite commands are not the commands that ran: after_suite.command reads 'PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/ITER/mcintos/crew 2>/dev/null; true' (a mangled fragment naming no interpreter and no test), and baseline_suite.command reads 'PYTHONPATH=base-tree <41 base test files>' with an unresolved placeholder rather than literal paths. The real commands survive only in the arm log headers (head_arm.log:5 '... -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 -q <gate_files.txt>'; base_arm.log:5 with an absolute scratch tree), so the manifest's own fields cannot be reconciled to the logs they name and are unreadable under the manifest contract's literal-command rule; the arms themselves are green and reproduce.
